description: Mac reference outputs for Demo_Lab: the model's maps BEFORE post-processing (made on MPS, Python 3.9.6, torch 2.8.0, before any portability change). Used by check_install.py --full, which compares them with the raw copies (Fused_St_Filt_Comp_Seg_Raw.tif) written next to each result; the keys name the result's location (Fused_St_Filt_Comp_Seg_Mod.tif, post-processed since version 1.1.0).
source_reference: the Mac reference predictions of the official test images (not included in this package)
